t: What Irrigation Efficiency Database Is All About
title: What Irrigation Efficiency Database Is All About
description: Irrigation efficiency is water to the root, not to the air: drip hits 90-95% efficiency, sprinklers 70-85%, flood 40-60%. Agriculture drinks ~70% of global freshwater. Deficit irrigation deliberately stresses crops at tolerant stages; soil moisture sensors schedule by need, not calendar. The cheapest water is the water not wasted. This database is the complete irrigation method: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.

t: Core Vocabulary of Irrigation Efficiency Database
